"""Review the research index or install its weekly macOS LaunchAgent."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import plistlib
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
INDEX = ROOT / "notes" / "index.md"
SOURCE = ROOT / "source"
REPORT = ROOT / "reports" / "weekly-review.md"
INLINE_LINK = re.compile(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]\n]*\]\(\s*(?:<([^>\n]+)>|([^\s)]+))')


def write_report():
    linked = set()
    for match in INLINE_LINK.finditer(INDEX.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
        destination = urlsplit(match.group(1) or match.group(2))
        path = Path(unquote(destination.path))
        if destination.scheme or destination.netloc or not destination.path or path.is_absolute():
            continue
        linked.add((INDEX.parent / path).resolve())

    pdfs = {
        path.resolve() for path in SOURCE.rglob("*")
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() == ".pdf"
    }
    missing = sorted(path for path in linked if not path.exists())
    unlisted = sorted(pdfs - linked)
    lines = [
        "# Weekly research index review",
        "",
        f"Generated {datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(timespec='seconds')}.",
        f"PDFs linked from the index: {len(pdfs & linked)} of {len(pdfs)}.",
        "",
    ]
    for heading, paths in (
        ("Missing index link targets", missing),
        ("PDFs missing from the index", unlisted),
    ):
        lines.extend([f"## {heading}", ""])
        lines.extend([f"- `{os.path.relpath(path, ROOT)}`" for path in paths] or ["None."])
        lines.append("")

    REPORT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with NamedTemporaryFile(
        mode="w", encoding="utf-8", dir=REPORT.parent, delete=False
    ) as temporary:
        temporary_path = Path(temporary.name)
        try:
            temporary.write("\n".join(lines))
            temporary.close()
            temporary_path.replace(REPORT)
        finally:
            temporary_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def install_agent():
    if sys.platform != "darwin":
        raise SystemExit("LaunchAgent installation requires macOS.")

    identifier = hashlib.sha256(os.fsencode(ROOT)).hexdigest()[:12]
    label = f"local.research-index-review.{identifier}"
    agents = Path.home() / "Library" / "LaunchAgents"
    agents.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    agent = agents / f"{label}.plist"
    domain = f"gui/{os.getuid()}"
    service = f"{domain}/{label}"
    launchctl = ["launchctl"]

    subprocess.run([*launchctl, "print", domain], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    REPORT.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with agent.open("wb") as stream:
        plistlib.dump({
            "Label": label,
            "ProgramArguments": [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve())],
            "WorkingDirectory": str(ROOT),
            "StartCalendarInterval": {"Weekday": 1, "Hour": 9, "Minute": 0},
            "StandardErrorPath": str(REPORT.parent / "weekly-review-errors.log"),
        }, stream)

    loaded = subprocess.run(
        [*launchctl, "print", service], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL
    )
    if loaded.returncode == 0:
        subprocess.run([*launchctl, "bootout", service], check=True)
    subprocess.run([*launchctl, "bootstrap", domain, str(agent)], check=True)
    subprocess.run([*launchctl, "print", service], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    print("Registered for Mondays at 9:00 a.m. local time.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--install", action="store_true", help="register the macOS LaunchAgent")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    write_report()
    if args.install:
        install_agent()
